name: Michele Donato

records.what: Scilla, Nati 1892, atto 162 — named as the father, aged 36, pescatore

corrections: The tree puts his birth at Scilla in 1851. Act 162 of 1892 makes him THIRTY-SIX in July 1892, so born about 1856 -- and gives him a trade the tree does not record, pescatore. But the Scilla birth indexes for 1851, 1856 and 1859 each hold a complete D section and NONE of them has a Donato in it, while 1892 has two Donato households. On this evidence the surname arrives at Scilla between 1859 and 1892 and he was probably born in another comune. CONFIRMED INDEPENDENTLY: the New Orleans manifest of 1908 records him aged 52, off the Liguria -- a birth about 1856, agreeing with act 162 and not with the tree's 1851. And the 'Donato arrived at Scilla late' hypothesis is dead: fifteen Donato gave Scilla as their last residence at Ellis Island between 1893 and 1921.

name: Rocco Arena

records.what: NAA passenger arrivals index — the Sydney, 27 Dec 1953
Ellis Island, 21 March 1900 — the Trave out of Genoa, aged 39, of Scilla, a US citizen

corrections: THE CONFLICT RESOLVES. The tree makes him the son of Orazio Arena and Giovana Zirilli; act 228 of 1861 says Francesco Antonio Arena, marinaro, and Serafina Arlotta, and 1861 holds exactly one Rocco Arena. Three independent strands now favour the register: 1861 has only that one Rocco; Rocco is a marinaro in 1893 and Francesco Antonio is a marinaro in 1861, a trade passed father to son; and this manifest gives a Rocco Arena of Scilla, married, aged 39 in March 1900 -- born about 1861. THE TREE'S YEAR IS RIGHT AND ITS PARENTS ARE ALMOST CERTAINLY WRONG. Manifest ages are approximate, so this is a year loose and does not pin the date; what it rules out is a birth far from 1861. He was also in America long enough to naturalise. QUALIFIED THE SAME DAY: act 60 of 1858 is ANOTHER Rocco Arena, born 23 April 1858 to Santo Arena and Giovanna Gioffre. So it is no longer true that only one Rocco Arena of roughly the right age exists. The arithmetic still favours 1861 -- 38 against the manifest's 39, where the 1858 boy would be 41 -- but the identification is not clean.

corrections: The export carries her twice as Orazio Arena's wife: undated here, and as Giovanna Zirilli b. 1827 with a son Guiseppe. Act 46 shows a single couple at Scilla in 1859.
